title: QA Automation Engineer
text:
QA Automation Engineer - Sample Health Tech Pvt Ltd, Gurugram
2 to 4 years

Responsibilities
- Automate web tests with Selenium WebDriver and Java
- Test APIs with Postman and Rest Assured
- Write and run manual test cases for new features
- Log defects in Jira and track them to closure
- Run regression suites in the Jenkins pipeline

Must have
- Selenium with Java
- API testing (Postman)
- Test case design
- Jira

Nice to have
- Cypress or Playwright
- Load testing with JMeter
- Experience with BrowserStack

Notice: 30 days preferred.
